name: 69-r11-snapshot-probe-bare-runtimeerror
concern: #69 r11 finding 5：快照路径的 isinstance 探测同样不得漏裸异常
old:
try:
        return isinstance(value, classes)
    except Exception as exc:                # noqa: BLE001 - 宿主 __getattribute__ 的任意异常
        raise StateSnapshotError(message=(
            f"state snapshot cannot probe {type(value).__name__!r}: its host class "
            f"raises from __getattribute__ while isinstance() reads __class__ "
            f"({exc})")) from exc
rationale: 摘掉 `state._snapshot_isinstance` 的具名包装：`_snapshot_value(<宿主钩子抛异常的对象>)` 重新漏出**裸** `RuntimeError`（r6 起，DSL 可达）而不是 `StateSnapshotError`。由 finding 5 的正常 FAILED 行杀死。
